props.name: ratio
props.description: Width over height: a number (`1.5`) or a ratio string (`"16/9"`, `"4:3"`). Unparseable strings fall back to a square.

props.name: fit
props.description: How an image, video or iframe child fills the box.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually one img, video, iframe or picture. It is stretched to the box.
